purpose: Make the already frozen dense_ws evaluator thresholds deterministic enough to implement without reading results or choosing semantics after results are known.

input_identity_and_ordering.required_input: one future immutable materialization-bound evaluator PlanOnly whose hashes match the frozen campaign, quality report and causal materialization
input_identity_and_ordering.raw_bbo_source_ordinal: valid segment chain order, then normalized relative file path ascending, then one-based JSONL line number ascending
input_identity_and_ordering.latest_quote_tie_break: maximum recv_ts not after execution_ts, then maximum raw_bbo_source_ordinal

candidate_and_risk_admission.candidate_trigger: the exact frozen displayed normal net edge, capacity, regime and causal snapshot rules
candidate_and_risk_admission.candidate_order_with_equal_sample_ts: campaign universe row index, then fixed direction rank
candidate_and_risk_admission.cooldown_resolution: the hash-bound 60-second per-base risk cooldown is stricter and takes precedence; it also satisfies the frozen per-base-and-direction cooldown
candidate_and_risk_admission.cooldown_boundary: a new candidate is eligible when signal_sample_ts - prior_admitted_base_sample_ts >= 60 seconds
candidate_and_risk_admission.cooldown_starts_on: admitted signal before outcome lookup, regardless of later fillability
candidate_and_risk_admission.capital_reservation_interval: half-open [signal_sample_ts, signal_sample_ts + 1.0 second), using the frozen maximum execution latency
candidate_and_risk_admission.holding_interpretation: a paired taker event resolves within the one-second reservation interval; any event exceeding 25 seconds is an integrity failure, never an extended-hold PnL observation
candidate_and_risk_admission.suppressed_candidate_treatment: not a selected event and not included in fill, expectancy, PnL or bootstrap denominators; report a reason counter

scenario_realization_and_economics.unfillable_in_profit_factor: zero observation; contributes to neither gross profit nor gross loss
scenario_realization_and_economics.expectancy_bps: sum effective event net edge bps divided by all selected events in the metric window
scenario_realization_and_economics.fill_rate: paired fills divided by all selected events in the same scenario and metric window

primary_train_oos_split.population: all admitted selected events before any outcome-based filtering
primary_train_oos_split.timestamp_group: all selected events sharing exactly the same signal_sample_ts
primary_train_oos_split.train_boundary: the last complete timestamp group whose cumulative event count is not greater than target_train_count
primary_train_oos_split.train_membership: all complete groups through the train boundary
primary_train_oos_split.embargo_membership: events after the train boundary with signal_sample_ts < last_train_sample_ts + 300 seconds

sample_gate_scope.minimum_total_independent_events: all admitted selected events before split
sample_gate_scope.minimum_oos_events: primary OOS selected events after embargo
sample_gate_scope.minimum_events_per_direction: primary OOS selected events separately for each frozen direction
sample_gate_scope.minimum_events_per_walk_forward_fold: selected events in each primary-OOS test fold

five_fold_walk_forward.test_horizon: the complete primary OOS timestamp-group sequence after embargo
five_fold_walk_forward.boundary_selection: for each target choose the first complete timestamp group whose cumulative event count reaches or exceeds the target
five_fold_walk_forward.folds: five contiguous, non-overlapping test slices covering every primary OOS selected event exactly once
five_fold_walk_forward.train_prefix_for_fold: primary train plus all earlier OOS folds; recorded for audit but never used to refit formulas, regimes, thresholds or directions
five_fold_walk_forward.per_fold_embargo: none, because nothing is refit or learned between folds
five_fold_walk_forward.positive_fold_definition: normal scenario fold net PnL quote greater than zero

cluster_block_bootstrap.metric: primary OOS normal effective net edge bps including zero for unfillable selected events
cluster_block_bootstrap.resampling_unit: entire UTC-hour clusters sampled with replacement; retain all events and their order inside each drawn cluster
cluster_block_bootstrap.draws_per_replicate: the original number of distinct OOS UTC-hour clusters
cluster_block_bootstrap.counter_rng: for zero-based replicate r and draw j, SHA-256(seed_hash_bytes || r as unsigned 8-byte big-endian || j as unsigned 8-byte big-endian); use the first unsigned 8-byte big-endian word modulo cluster_count
cluster_block_bootstrap.replicate_statistic: arithmetic mean of all effective net edge bps observations in the drawn clusters
cluster_block_bootstrap.lower_bound: one-sided 95 percent nearest-rank lower bound: sorted_estimates[ceil(0.05 * replicates) - 1]

metric_edge_cases.profit_factor_gross_profit: sum of strictly positive event net PnL quote
metric_edge_cases.profit_factor_gross_loss: absolute sum of strictly negative event net PnL quote
metric_edge_cases.profit_factor_when_no_loss_and_positive_: numeric value null plus profit_factor_infinite=true; passes any finite minimum
metric_edge_cases.profit_factor_when_no_gain_and_no_loss: 0.0 plus profit_factor_infinite=false; fails positive economics gates
metric_edge_cases.drawdown_population: primary OOS normal event PnL including zero for unfillable events
metric_edge_cases.drawdown_order: execution_ts, signal_sample_ts, campaign universe row index, direction rank
metric_edge_cases.drawdown_formula: maximum peak minus cumulative equity, with cumulative equity and initial peak both starting at zero
metric_edge_cases.concentration_population: strictly positive primary OOS normal event PnL only; negative events never offset a positive group
metric_edge_cases.event_concentration: largest positive event PnL divided by total positive event PnL
metric_edge_cases.base_hour_direction_concentration: sum positive event PnL by base, signal UTC-hour bucket or direction divided by total positive event PnL
metric_edge_cases.concentration_when_no_positive_pnl: all concentration shares equal 1.0 and fail the gate
metric_edge_cases.direction_expectancy_denominator: all selected primary OOS events in that direction, including unfillable zero observations

numeric_and_hash_determinism.arithmetic: finite IEEE-754 binary64 with no intermediate metric rounding
numeric_and_hash_determinism.threshold_comparison: unrounded finite values and the exact frozen strict or inclusive operator
numeric_and_hash_determinism.canonical_json: UTF-8, sorted object keys, compact separators, arrays retained in contract order
numeric_and_hash_determinism.event_id: SHA-256 canonical JSON of campaign plan hash, materialization-bound plan hash, signal_sample_ts, base and direction
numeric_and_hash_determinism.repeat_hash_payload: source and code hashes, exact event-file SHA-256, deterministic metrics, gate results and historical verdict

gate_order_and_ceiling.sample_failure: INSUFFICIENT_DATA_NOT_REJECTED and stop before economics verdict

future_runtime_outputs.atomic_write: write each artifact to a same-directory temporary file, fsync, then replace once complete

allowed_after_exact_approval: implement one visible bounded evaluator wrapper
run synthetic fixture and static contract tests only
create an immutable code and wrapper hash manifest
